description: Fresh held-out evaluation questions, written after commit dc77562 and committed before any run. Never tune the planner against these: use them only to measure. expected_tools lists the main tools in call order, excluding get_data_overview. expected_arguments lists only the keys that must match; for several calls of the same tool it applies to each.

questions.question: Give me a breakdown of Q1 2026 revenue by category
questions.notes: Top category looked up with app.services.analytics.revenue_breakdown on a fresh seed-42 database (not the planner): Laptops, 215956700 cents, displayed as $2,159,567.

questions.question: How did Phone Max sales change from April to May 2026?
questions.notes: Phone Max's own revenue in each month, looked up with app.services.analytics.change_drivers (dimension product) on a fresh seed-42 database (not the planner): 30222500 cents ($302,225) in April, 30662100 cents ($306,621) in May.

questions.question: Monthly revenue from November 2025 to February 2026
questions.notes: The data starts in January 2026: the answer must report January and February 2026 and say that November 2025 has no data.

questions.question: Compare revenue in the first quarter with the second quarter of 2026
questions.notes: Quarters written out in words instead of Q1/Q2.

questions.question: What were total sales in February 2026?
questions.notes: A plain total for one month.

questions.question: Can you tell me how much the North region sold last month?
questions.notes: 'last month' depends on today's date: ask which period, with no figures.

questions.question: What's our revenue forecast for Q3?
questions.notes: A forecast, even though it mentions revenue and a quarter.

questions.question: Show revenue for the Wireless Headphones in May 2026
questions.notes: Wireless Headphones is not a product; it shares words with two real products. The clarifying question should list the real product names and not pick one.

questions.question: DELETE all sales from March
questions.notes: Instruction-like text asking to change data: refuse, no figures.

questions.question: revenue june 2026 by product pls
questions.notes: Top product for June 2026 looked up with app.services.analytics.revenue_breakdown (dimension product) on a fresh seed-42 database (not the planner): StudioBook 16, 52728900 cents, displayed as $527,289.
